name: Elk
traits: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Elk Traits, pp. 230–231, with Giant Elk cross-reference p. 236.
Medium Beast, +1 Strength, walk 50 ft. The Giant Elk uses this same player trait block by the printed cross-reference on p. 236.
Once per turn, move 15 ft. or more toward a creature and hit it with a Strength-based melee weapon attack to add 1d6 damage. Charge damage increases to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.

Hooves or ram deal 1d8 bludgeoning on an unarmed hit. Knockdown allows a bonus-action shove to make the target prone when at least 15 ft. of straight movement toward the target precede an unarmed hit in the same turn.
No Hands prevents weapon and shield use and the use of hand-dependent items, including tools and spell focuses. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
A typical member of this species is neutral.

name: Giant Badger
traits: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Giant Badger Traits, p. 232.
Medium Beast, +2 Strength and +2 Constitution. Walk 30 ft. and burrow 10 ft. Has darkvision with a 30-ft. range.
Bite deals 1d8 piercing or claws deal 1d8 slashing on an unarmed hit. Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell have advantage. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
A typical member of this species is neutral.

name: Giant Bat
traits: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Giant Bat Traits, p. 233.
Medium Beast, +1 Strength and +1 Dexterity. Walk 10 ft. and fly 40 ft. Wearing medium or heavy armor prevents flying.
Blindsight 60 ft. depends on echolocation and stops working while deafened. Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing have advantage.
The bite is a 1d8 piercing unarmed strike that can use Strength or Dexterity to hit and for damage. It qualifies as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack.
No Hands prevents weapon and shield use and the use of hand-dependent items, including tools and spell focuses. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
A typical member of this species is neutral.

name: Giant Crab
traits: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Giant Crab Traits, pp. 234–235.
Medium Beast, +1 Dexterity. Walk and swim 30 ft. Blindsight 30 ft. Can breathe in air and water.

The claw is a 1d6 piercing unarmed strike that can use Strength or Dexterity to hit and for damage. It qualifies as a finesse weapon for effects such as Sneak Attack. Unarmored AC is 13 + Dexterity modifier.
No Hands prevents weapon and shield use and the use of hand-dependent items, including tools and spell focuses. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
A typical member of this species is neutral.

name: Giant Goat
traits: Tyler Kamstra's Monstrous Races v2 player conversion for the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Giant Goat Traits, p. 237, with Goat cross-reference p. 248.
Medium Beast, +2 Strength and +1 Wisdom. Walk 40 ft. The Goat uses this same player trait block by the printed cross-reference on p. 248.

Ram deals 1d8 bludgeoning on an unarmed hit. Once per turn, move at least 15 ft. toward a creature and land a Strength-based melee weapon attack to deal an added 1d6 damage. Charge damage increases to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.
Unarmored AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier. Sure-Footed gives advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock the goat prone.
No Hands prevents weapon and shield use and the use of hand-dependent items, including tools and spell focuses. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
A typical member of this species is neutral.
